نتبادر (form VI)
# نَتَبَادَرُ (natabādaru) /na.ta.baː.da.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
# نُتَبَادَرُ (nutabādaru) /nu.ta.baː.da.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
# نَتَبَادَرَ (natabādara) /na.ta.baː.da.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
# نُتَبَادَرَ (nutabādara) /nu
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
